outline:
#122 驗證者抓到:真 codex(auto-fix 不帶 --json)撞額度只印純文字 ERROR: You've hit your usage limit …,classify 回 other,#116/#121/#132 的換候選在真環境從沒觸發;夾具都印 JSON 信封所以綠。
選法:classify 認 log 結尾連續的 ERROR: 行(常數 CLI_ERROR_PREFIX),不改成 codex --json。理由:--json 要動 CODEX_COMMAND(test_a9 golden 釘死)、整份 log 變 JSONL(人讀、cost 信封判讀都要跟著改),而 codex --json 撞額度時是否真的印信封未實測;結尾規則只動 classify 一個函式。只看結尾是因為 log 中段可能有 unittest 的 ERROR: test_… 行;codex 有時在額度行後再印 "tokens used\n<數字>" 收尾(t115 三份真 log),判讀前先略過這段(#133 第 1 輪反駁 accepted)。
Ready 前檢查(讀 a97df99;t122 頭 9548f38 的 classify 與 main 相同):F 在 —— 兩份真 log 跑 classify --rc 1 都回 other(實測)。既有 text429/plain429/'429 rate limit' 夾具最後一行都不是 ERROR: 開頭,新規則下仍 other(讀 code 推得,未跑)。agy 帶 stream-json,錯誤走信封,不在本票。
順序:疊在 t122 上(D-052),之後 #104 疊在本票上。

objections.body: reports/t115/20261014-004955-67518/worker-round1.log is not a "mid-log ERROR: test_… only" log: lines 68575–68576 are the real codex usage-limit ERROR: lines, followed by a "tokens used / 189,715" footer (68577–68578); under the ticket's tail-only rule it classifies as other (measured), so codex runs that print the footer after hitting quota still never fall back, and the verifier plan's "t115 → other" would pin that false negative.

triage.reason: reports/t115/20261014-004955-67518/worker-round1.log ends with two real codex usage-limit ERROR: lines followed by a "tokens used / 189,715" footer, so the tail-only rule would miss real quota hits and the verifier plan would pin that false negative.

objections.body: verify/dispatch/test_ticket_133.py:126-127 asserts the "middle-error" fixture (the t115 worker-round1.log tail: two real usage-limit ERROR: lines + "tokens used / 189,715") classifies as other, but acceptance A1 (amended after the accepted round-1 objection) and the test_plan's verifier line both require that exact shape to be quota_exhausted; the verifier file must flip that expectation (or move the case into test_a1), the product code is correct.
